parsed.scene_description: The image shows a large industrial space with a concrete floor and white walls. There are three workers in the image, two of whom are wearing orange vests and one is wearing a black jacket. They are walking towards a red machine that appears to be a conveyor belt. The machine is moving along the floor and there are yellow railings on either side of the image. Above the machine, there is a large circular light fixture hanging from the ceiling. The workers appear to be inspecting or inspecting the machine.
